summary: A dance performance video for the debut single, and the reaction is built almost entirely on effort recognition — viewers keep noting that none of the three are trained dancers and that the result is still tight, neither overdone nor thin. The T-Pop Stage demand appears again as the top comment, framed as something they are waiting for rather than suggesting. Natty's dancing is singled out. Underneath it all is the same standing request as the MV thread: stop calling this a side project and debut properly.

audience_signals: A dance performance video earned 2.1M views on its own, roughly three times the audio teaser — performance content is a distinct, high-reach asset class the channel has only used once
Visible effort from non-specialists reads as authenticity and earns more goodwill than technical polish would
The T-Pop Stage request has now appeared across every music-related post in the top ten — it is the single most consistent unmet ask in the corpus
